mapper.select: SELECT og.sys_id AS order_group_id, om.sys_id AS order_master_id, om.link_sys_id AS table_sys_id, og.order_status, om.order_status AS master_status FROM order_group og INNER JOIN order_master om ON om.sys_id = og.link_sys_id AND om.sys_plant_cd = og.sys_plant_cd WHERE og.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} AND og.sys_id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO client_order_revision ( sys_id, sys_plant_cd, client_request_id, order_master_id, table_sys_id, request_fingerprint, processing_status, insert_user_id, insert_datetime ) VALUES ( #{revisionId}, #{sysPlantCd}, #{clientRequestId}, #{orderMasterId}, #{tableSysId}, #{fingerprint}, 'PROCESSING', #{userId}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (sys_plant_cd, client_request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT use_yn FROM table_info WHERE sys_id = #{tableSysId} AND sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} AND delete_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE

SELECT og.sys_id AS order_group_id, om.sys_id AS order_master_id, om.link_sys_id AS table_sys_id, og.order_status, om.order_status AS master_status FROM order_group og INNER JOIN order_master om ON om.sys_id = og.link_sys_id AND om.sys_plant_cd = og.sys_plant_cd WHERE og.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} AND og.sys_id IN #{id} ORDER BY og.sys_id FOR UPDATE OF og

mapper.select: SELECT og.sys_id FROM order_group og WHERE og.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} AND og.sys_id IN #{id} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_detail od WHERE od.link_sys_id3 = og.sys_id AND od.sys_plant_cd = og.sys_plant_cd AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM client_order_revision_removed_detail removed WHERE removed.order_detail_sys_id = od.sys_id ) ) ORDER BY og.sys_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_group (sys_id, cancel_yn, cancel_reason, insert_user_id, insert_datetime, sys_plant_cd, link_sys_id, order_num, order_status) VALUES (#{orderId}, 'N', '', #{userId}, #{orderedAt}, #{sysPlantCd}, #{orderMasterId}, #{orderNumber}, '01')
